summary: Test builds a fixture repo containing only specs/codex-session-scrollback.md and specs/other-spec.md with NO .2119.yml, then asserts buildContext reports notInitialized false and discovers both stems through the real default glob; narrowing the default in a scratch copy to 'specs/**/<prefix>-*.md' fails this test, and REQ-011.5.1's config-free fixture covers the legacy-parity half.
